import json, sys
from pathlib import Path
import molsysmt as msm
assert Path(msm.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(Path.cwd())
assert sys.version_info[:2] == (3, 14)
print(json.dumps({'python':sys.version,'molsysmt':msm.__file__,'version':msm.__version__}))

acceptance: Public terminal addition resolves source atoms once; group-index context survives atom sorting. Local repair and selected component capping have explicit scopes, empty selections copy, invalid inputs preserve the source and real external MDTraj input preserves its form.

The terminal assessment public numeric axis stays groups, but chain context is complete before report filtering. Internal selected groups are not invented termini; unrelated unknown-chain populations do not invalidate a selected known chain.

Covalent component endpoint keys locate caps independently of stable molecules. Both real two-peptide forms return 104 atoms after repairing the missing CB. Native stable molecule count remains two; MDTraj derives five connected molecules from its retained orphan H atoms, matching its own source interpretation.

Catalog summaries match public inventory/independent manifest at 22 atoms. Both original catalog cells re-execute with an actual source/kernel identity probe. Other course/guide/cookbook code and outputs remain exact.

PDB producer reads cached runtime version, retains long/unknown versions losslessly in <=80-column REMARK records and keeps creation time. All selected scientific PDB records remain exact. The @2 owned benchmark preparation is reversible and leaves scientific/caller input bytes untouched.
170 expanded real/reference/doctest controls, sixteen tiny benchmark/evidence controls (two actual 21-path campaigns), fourteen fast gates and five inspected HTML pages pass on clean c643a728f.
preserved_failures: Original directed control: twelve failures/six passes reproduce numeric/group mismatch, empty selection behavior, invalid-type diagnostics, catalog count and writer attribution.

First correction: a local imported basic.set shadows the Python builtin in the new group projection. Use np.unique. The bound pandas wrapper classes differ between independent copies; compare their actual DataFrame payloads rather than wrapper class identity.
Extended fixture used a nonexistent MolSys.get_n_structures convenience method; use public get(n_structures=True).
Both actual two-component routes expose #684 independently: 92 versus 104 atoms. The corrected component-anchor mapping passes.

A later inventory assertion wrongly assumed MDTraj stores native stable molecule declarations. It derives connected molecules and reports five from the orphan-H fixture, while native retains two. The final guard compares each supported form with its own source and separately requires two native stable molecules. No production conversion contract is relaxed.
limits: No new scientific placement method, energy minimization, chemical-state completion or force-field assignment is claimed. Existing unassessed/loss/binary-compatibility warnings are retained.
No native backend rebuild or package/dependency installation/floor/schema change.
The initial 170/16 collections overlap existing coverage and are not a complete-suite total. Tiny timings are evidence-transport controls, not a performance ranking.
The catalog kernel emits its default localhost TCP warning; that evidence is retained. Other notebooks receive narrative-only changes.
The four core repairs add zero weighted milestone credit. Incoming addon PRs #678/#681/#682/#683 require separate combined-source and actual GUI receiving.
No package/tag/Release, remote-CI dispatch, promotion or final 1.0 acceptance.
